content.bridge_context: Understanding how India stays united despite having so many different languages, religions, and traditions.

units.title: What is Diversity?
units.explanation: Diversity means variety - the many ways we are different from one another.
units.dual_language_instruction: How many different languages do people in your class speak? / आपकी कक्षा के लोग कितनी अलग-अलग भाषाएं बोलते हैं?

units.title: Common Identity
units.explanation: Despite our differences, we all share a common identity as Indians.
units.dual_language_instruction: What is our national anthem? / हमारा राष्ट्रगान क्या है?
